prompts.title: Generate CSC KPI for Work Effort
prompts.prompt: Review the Desired Outcomes and Project Objectives, then propose CSC, KPI, KPI value type, and KPI target date for this work effort.
prompts.description: As a Project Manager, review the Desired Outcome(s) and Project Objective(s) to generate CSC, KPI, KPI Value Type, and KPI Target Date for the work effort. Use this prompt to structure measurable items that can be tracked throughout the project lifecycle.
prompts.author: Rathinam, Archana [TECH]
prompts.tip: Ensure the Project Description and Project Objective are clear, concise and explained in laymen terms for an effective output. Review the outcome with the Product owner or sponsor before entering it in PTS.

prompts.title: Review CSC KPI and Refine Project Description for Projects
prompts.prompt: Given an existing project description and KPIs, identify gaps and suggest refined wording for the CSC KPIs and project description.
prompts.description: CSC is Critical Success Criteria; this prompt helps validate that measurable terms of what must be done for the work effort to be considered successful are clearly defined and aligned with project objectives.
prompts.author: Rathinam, Archana [TECH]

title: Release Engineering Agent Prompt Catalog
subtitle: Automates release pipelines, version management, and deployment artifact generation.

prompts.title: Write User Story from Feature Brief
prompts.prompt: From this feature brief and acceptance criteria, draft a user story in the format: As a [role], I want [goal] so that [benefit], plus acceptance criteria.
prompts.description: Given a feature brief and acceptance criteria, generate a well-formed user story in the format: As a [role], I want [goal] so that [benefit]. Include clear acceptance criteria and definition of done.
prompts.author: Sarah Chen [PROD]

prompts.title: Refine Backlog and Prioritize by Value
prompts.prompt: Review this backlog and propose a prioritized list of items based on business value, dependencies, and risk, with a brief rationale for each.
prompts.description: Review the current backlog items and suggest a priority order based on business value, dependencies, and risk. Output a ranked list with short justification for each.
prompts.author: David Park [PROD]

prompts.title: Sprint Planning Checklist
prompts.prompt: Generate a sprint planning checklist that covers capacity, sprint goal, story selection, task breakdown, and commitment items.
prompts.description: Generate a sprint planning checklist: capacity check, goal setting, story selection, task breakdown, and commitment. Include prompts for team discussion.
prompts.author: Sarah Chen [PROD]

prompts.title: Rollback Runbook from Release Notes
prompts.prompt: From these release notes and deployment steps, create a rollback runbook with pre-conditions, rollback steps, verification, and escalation contacts.
prompts.description: From the provided release notes and deployment steps, generate a concise rollback runbook: pre-conditions, rollback steps, verification, and contact escalation.
prompts.author: Ops Team [INFRA]

prompts.title: Incident Summary for Post-Mortem
prompts.prompt: Using this incident information, draft a post-mortem summary with timeline, impact, suspected root cause, and follow-up actions.
prompts.description: Draft an incident summary suitable for a blameless post-mortem: timeline, impact, root cause, and suggested follow-up actions.
prompts.author: Ops Team [INFRA]

prompts.title: Deployment Checklist
prompts.prompt: Create a deployment checklist for this release that covers pre-deploy checks, deployment steps, smoke tests, and sign-off.
prompts.description: Generate a deployment checklist for a production release: pre-deploy checks, deployment steps, smoke tests, and sign-off criteria.
prompts.author: Release Eng [INFRA]

prompts.title: Generate Implementation Plan from Ticket
prompts.prompt: From this Jira ticket or feature request, propose an implementation plan: impacted services, code changes, tests, and rollout steps.
prompts.description: Given a Jira ticket or feature request, generate an implementation plan: impacted services, code areas to touch, test strategy, and rollout steps.
prompts.author: Devin AI Team

prompts.title: Refactor Legacy Module Safely
prompts.prompt: Given this legacy module, recommend a refactoring approach, tests to add, and safety checks before deployment.
prompts.description: From a legacy code snippet, propose a refactoring plan with clearer structure, tests to add, and specific safety checks to run before deployment.
prompts.author: Devin AI Team

prompts.title: Draft Initial Incident Bridge Announcement
prompts.prompt: From these incident details, draft a concise bridge announcement: impact, start time, scope, known workarounds, and next update time.
prompts.description: Using current incident details (impact, symptoms, scope), draft a concise bridge announcement: what is impacted, when it started, known workarounds, and next update time.
prompts.author: Incident Mgmt [OPS]

prompts.title: Create Incident Timeline for Review
prompts.prompt: Based on these chat messages and alerts, build an incident timeline with key events, actions, and decisions.
prompts.description: From a list of chat messages and monitoring alerts, generate a clear incident timeline with key events, owner actions, and decision points.
prompts.author: Incident Mgmt [OPS]
